name: Giant Tank Sailing
description: The Giant Tank Sailing Adventure Park, nestled in Vavuniya, Sri Lanka, offers adrenaline-pumping water sports amidst scenic views. Established as a reservoir by the British colonial government in the early 20th century, the tank now serves as a popular spot for water sports enthusiasts. Visitors can rent out speedboats, kayaks, and paddleboards, zipping through the calm waters, enjoying breathtaking views of the surrounding countryside. Notable for its unique blend of adventure and natural beauty, the park attracts both locals and tourists seeking an exhilarating experience.
activities: Water Sports, Scenic Views, Adrenaline Thrills
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; check roads after rain

name: Madhu Forest Trek
